notes: New: a much bigger template library (File > New from Template). 65 formats and 100 designs in Social Media, Print (business cards, flyers, posters, postcards, rack cards, tri-fold brochures, letterhead, envelopes, menus, gift certificates, certificates, invitations, stickers, labels, door hangers, tickets, badges), Signs & Large Format (window clings, yard signs, vinyl banners, T-shirts), Logo & Brand (logos, brand style sheet, email signature, app icon), Ads & Web (display ads, website hero, link preview, email header) and Presentation. Print templates come with bleed, safety lines, fold guides and cut lines; front/back and multi-page designs open as several artboards. Plus search, any custom size, and My Templates (File > Save as Template).
